article.story: CAPE GIRARDEAU, Mo. -- — Braxton Stacker scored 15 points as Southeast Missouri State beat Eastern Illinois 68-59 on Thursday. Stacker had five rebounds for the Redhawks (7-7, 2-1 Ohio Valley Conference). BJ Ward went 4 of 9 from the field (3 for 6 from 3-point range) to add 11 points. Andre Washington led the way for the Panthers (4-9, 1-2) with 14 points. Eastern Illinois also got 13 points from Preston Turner. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
